japan.name: Tonkotsu Ramen
japan.story: Rich, creamy pork bone broth simmered for 18+ hours, served with springy thin noodles, tender chashu pork, and seasoned soft-boiled egg.
japan.whereToFind: Ichiran Shibuya or Fuunji Shinjuku for rich dipping tsukemen.
japan.tip: Customise your noodle firmness to 'katame' (firm) for best texture.

japan.name: Edomae Nigiri Sushi
japan.story: Tokyo's heritage sushi style featuring seasoned vinegared rice and pristine fresh fish from Toyosu and Tsukiji markets.
japan.whereToFind: Tsukiji Outer Market stalls or Ginza standing sushi bars.
japan.tip: Dip fish side down into soy sauce so the rice doesn't crumble.

japan.name: Takoyaki & Yakitori
japan.story: Golden octopus balls drizzled with savory sauce and bonito flakes, paired with charcoal-grilled skewered chicken.
japan.whereToFind: Omoide Yokocho in Shinjuku or Asakusa market alleyways.
japan.tip: Extremely hot inside when freshly cooked—eat carefully!

japan.name: Matcha Wagashi & Parfait
japan.story: Ceremonial Uji green tea paired with delicate handcrafted seasonal sweets made from sweet red bean paste and rice flour.
japan.whereToFind: Traditional teahouses near Asakusa and Uji matcha parlours.
japan.tip: Savor the subtle contrast between the bitter green tea and the sweet red bean.

shimla.name: Chana Madra
shimla.story: Classic Himachali celebratory dish made of chickpeas slow-cooked in a rich yogurt and aromatic spice gravy.
shimla.whereToFind: Himachali Rasoi on Mall Road, Shimla.
shimla.tip: Pairs wonderfully with piping hot steamed basmati rice.

shimla.name: Siddu with Pure Ghee
shimla.story: Traditional steamed wheat flour bread stuffed with spiced poppy seeds and walnut paste, drenched in pure desi ghee.
shimla.whereToFind: Street food stalls near The Ridge and Lakkar Bazaar.
shimla.tip: Eat it hot right out of the steamer during chilly evenings.

shimla.name: Dham Festive Thali
shimla.story: Heritage festive feast served during celebrations, featuring lentils, sweet rice (Meetha Bhaat), and sour curry (Khatta).
shimla.whereToFind: Heritage restaurants in Lower Bazaar and Mall Road.
shimla.tip: Cooked without onions or garlic by traditional Botis chefs.

shimla.name: Babru & Mountain Herbal Tea
shimla.story: Deep-fried wheat flatbread stuffed with spiced black gram paste, served with tamarind chutney and mountain herbal tea.
shimla.whereToFind: Teahouses overlooking the valley on Cart Road.
shimla.tip: The perfect rainy or foggy day warm snack.

jaipur.name: Dal Baati Churma
jaipur.story: Baked hard wheat balls (baati) soaked in pure ghee, served with spicy mixed lentil dal and sweet powdered wheat crumble (churma).
jaipur.whereToFind: Chokhi Dhani or Laxmi Mishthan Bhandar (LMB) in Johari Bazaar.
jaipur.tip: Crush the baati into pieces and ladle the hot dal and ghee generously.

jaipur.name: Pyaaz Kachori & Mirchi Vada
jaipur.story: Flaky golden deep-fried pastry generously stuffed with spicy caramelized onion filling, served with tangy tamarind chutney.
jaipur.whereToFind: Rawat Mishthan Bhandar near Jaipur Railway Station.
jaipur.tip: Rawat sells over 10,000 fresh kachoris every single day—arrive early for hot batches.

jaipur.name: Laal Maas
jaipur.story: Royal warrior curry prepared with tender mutton cooked in fiery Mathania red chilies and garlic curd gravy.
jaipur.whereToFind: Handi Restaurant on MI Road or Spice Court, Civil Lines.
jaipur.tip: Ask for medium spice if you are sensitive to fiery chilies.

jaipur.name: Ghevar & Malpua
jaipur.story: Traditional disc-shaped honeycomb sweet soaked in cardamom saffron syrup and garnished with thick mawa and silver leaf.
jaipur.whereToFind: LMB (Laxmi Mishthan Bhandar) in Johari Bazaar.
jaipur.tip: Malai Ghevar topped with reduced thickened milk is the most decadent version.

dubai.name: Emirati Chicken Machboos
dubai.story: Fragrant basmati rice slow-cooked with tender chicken, dried black limes (loomi), cardamom, cloves, and saffron.
dubai.whereToFind: Al Fanar Restaurant in Festival City or Al Khayma Heritage in Al Fahidi.
dubai.tip: The dried black lime imparts a distinctive zesty, earthy aroma.

dubai.name: Shawarma & Garlic Toum
dubai.story: Thinly sliced spit-roasted marinated chicken or lamb wrapped in soft warm pita with creamy garlic toum, pickles, and crispy fries.
dubai.whereToFind: Al Mallah on 2nd December Street or Operation: Falafel.
dubai.tip: Order with extra garlic toum for authentic flavor.

dubai.name: Luqaimat with Date Syrup
dubai.story: Golden crispy fried dough balls with a soft, airy center, drizzled generously with date molasses (dibs) and toasted sesame seeds.
dubai.whereToFind: Arabian Tea House in Al Fahidi Historical Neighbourhood.
dubai.tip: Best enjoyed warm alongside Arabic cardamom coffee (Gahwa).

dubai.name: Warm Cheese Kunafa
dubai.story: Shredded spun pastry soaked in sweet orange blossom syrup, layered with melted Akkawi cheese, and topped with crushed pistachios.
dubai.whereToFind: Feras Aldiyafa Sweets or Bosporus Turkish Restaurant.
dubai.tip: Eat it hot right as the cheese strings pull away from the dish.

chandigarh.name: Butter Chicken & Garlic Naan
chandigarh.story: Charcoal-grilled chicken tikka simmered in a velvet tomato, butter, and cashew nut cream sauce with fenugreek.
chandigarh.whereToFind: Pal Dhaba in Sector 28 or Baba Chicken in Sector 35.
chandigarh.tip: Dip freshly baked butter-brushed garlic naan directly into the thick sauce.

chandigarh.name: Amritsari Kulcha with Chole
chandigarh.story: Flaky layered bread stuffed with spiced mashed potatoes and onions, baked crisp in a clay tandoor and served with tangy chickpeas.
chandigarh.whereToFind: Bansal Amritsari Kulcha in Sector 37 or Stu-C (Panjab University).
chandigarh.tip: Crush the hot kulcha with your hands to release steam and let the butter melt in.

chandigarh.name: Sarson Ka Saag & Makki Di Roti
chandigarh.story: Slow-cooked spiced winter mustard leaves topped with white home-churned butter (makkhan), served with golden cornmeal flatbread.
chandigarh.whereToFind: Traditional Punjabi Dhabas across Sector 22 and 26.
chandigarh.tip: Complement with a chunk of jaggery (gur) on the side.

chandigarh.name: Kulfi Falooda & Sweet Lassi
chandigarh.story: Dense rabri kulfi cut into cubes and smothered with silky vermicelli falooda noodles, rose syrup, and sweet basil seeds.
chandigarh.whereToFind: Shiv Mishthan Bhandar or Sindhi Sweets in Sector 17 Plaza.
chandigarh.tip: The ultimate refreshing dessert on a warm afternoon stroll in Sector 17.
